newsitem.title: NORWAY: Trading at Oslo Bourse subdued ahead of FOMC.
newsitem.headline: Trading at Oslo Bourse subdued ahead of FOMC.

text.p: Norwegian shares were flat in quiet trade on Tuesday ahead of a meeting of U.S. central bank policy-makers in the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) later in the day, dealers said.
"Things are extremly quiet," a senior dealer said. "People seem to be sitting and waiting for an interest rate hike in the United States."
Oslo's Total share index edged down 0.07 percent to 1,122.28 points in turnover of 923 million crowns.
But nearly 200 million crowns worth of shares were traded in Fokus Bank partly because of an option, they said.

Fokus, whose share price was unchanged at 69 crowns, is fighting a hostile takeover bid from savings bank group Sparebankgruppen. Fokus is also locked in a takeover battle with Den norske Bank (DnB) for Trondheim-based mortgage lender BNbank.
